theme_central: Glorifying the Most High who creates, proportions and guides — revelation made easy for whoever wishes to remember, rooted in the ancient scrolls of Ibrahim and Musa.

branches.title: Glorifying the Most High
branches.resume: Allah creates, proportions harmoniously, determines and guides, brings forth pasture then withers it.

children.t: Glorification of the Most High, perfectly proportioned creation

branches.title: Revelation made easy
branches.resume: The Prophet will recite without forgetting except by Allah's will; the easiest way is made easy for him.

children.t: Recitation made easy, the easiest way assured

branches.title: The useful reminder
branches.resume: Remind if the reminder benefits; the one who fears will remember, the most wretched will turn away.

children.t: The reminder benefits the one who fears; fate of the most wretched in Hell

branches.title: Success through purification
branches.resume: He succeeds who purifies himself and prays; the hereafter is better, found in the ancient scrolls of Ibrahim and Musa.

children.t: Success through purification and prayer, wisdom of the ancient scrolls
